raw_to_lerobot_mapping: raw frame i == LeRobot frame i for i=0..1645; raw frame 1646 is dropped

annotation_convention.semantic_span: Starts when purposeful motion for the subgoal begins and ends when that subgoal is completed and control transitions toward the next subgoal.
annotation_convention.core_span: Stricter physical-interaction interval, using visible object motion/contact plus robot control signals.
annotation_convention.evaluation_note: Use semantic spans for phase segmentation. Use core spans for strict manipulation-boundary evaluation. Boundary tolerance reflects visual ambiguity, not model uncertainty.

steps.evidence: Base translational velocity becomes sustained above the motion threshold at ~34 and returns to near zero by ~135.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手打开洗碗机门
steps.evidence: Head view shows the right hand approach/contact the door around 145-154; door opening is visually complete by ~220. A right-gripper command transition occurs near frame 154.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手拉出碗篮
steps.evidence: After door opening, the right hand reaches the large dish rack; visible outward rack motion develops in the 300s and the interaction terminates near the strong gripper transition at frame 410.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手拉出餐具篮
steps.evidence: Head view shows the small mesh cutlery basket being engaged and pulled outward; right-gripper transitions occur around 474 and 522, and the hand begins leaving the basket by ~555.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手夹取刀放到餐具篮中
steps.evidence: The right hand moves from the pulled-out basket toward the utensils, grasps the knife around the gripper event at 619, transports it to the basket, and releases around 719 before returning toward the plate.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手夹取叉子放到餐具篮中
steps.evidence: The right hand returns to the pink plate, grasps the fork around frame 790, transports it to the cutlery basket, and finishes the placement around the gripper transition near frame 947.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手推入餐具篮
steps.evidence: Immediately after fork placement, the right hand remains at the small basket and pushes it inward; the interaction ends around the strong gripper transition at frame 1072, after which the hand retracts toward the plate.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手夹取盘子放到碗篮中
steps.evidence: The right hand moves to the pink plate, grasps it near frame 1112, carries it into the large rack, performs placement adjustments, and releases/completes placement around frame 1370.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手推入碗篮
steps.evidence: After releasing the plate, the right hand engages the large rack and pushes it back into the dishwasher; the rack is seated and the hand disengages around the strong gripper event at frame 1455.

steps.instruction_zh: 机器人用右手合上洗碗机门
steps.evidence: The right hand transitions from the rack to the door, begins lifting/closing the door around 1510, reaches the closed state around the gripper event at 1593, and retracts by ~1605.
